title: Negation with لَيْسَ
lede: Say what a person, place or thing is not, then choose a different negative system when the time frame or sentence type changes.

items.feedback: لَيْسَ negates identity/state and takes an accusative single-word predicate.
Feminine third-person singular is لَيْسَتْ.
First-person singular is لَسْتُ.
لَسْنَا + accusative human plural predicate.

items.prompt: Which negates a present action rather than a state?
items.feedback: لَا + present verb negates an action/habit; لَيْسَ negates a nominal state.
Past negation of a state is commonly لَمْ يَكُنْ.
Feminine agreement; predicate accusative.

items.prompt: Choose “The students are not in the classroom.”
items.feedback: Formal verb-first لَيْسَ may remain singular before an overt plural subject; the phrase after فِي stays genitive.
Human plural subject first → full agreement.
Second-person feminine is لَسْتِ.

options: A present state, identity or description
items.feedback: لَيْسَ is the central negative of the nominal sentence.

items.prompt: Choose the correct masculine singular form.
items.feedback: Noun nominative; single-word predicate accusative.

items.prompt: Choose the correct feminine singular form.
items.feedback: Feminine agreement and correct case pattern.
First-person form; feminine predicate if the speaker is female.
لَسْنَ + accusative feminine plural predicate.
The prepositional predicate keeps its own genitive noun.
لَا + present negates present/habitual action.
لَمْ يَكُنْ places the negative state in the past.
لَنْ يَكُونَ gives future negation.

Use لَيْسَ before every negative sentence.
items.feedback: Arabic negation depends on sentence type and time frame.

games.p: The students are not in the library.
games.e: Subject-first human plural takes full agreement.
Past state negation uses لَمْ يَكُنْ.

games.p: The weather will not be cold tomorrow.
games.e: Future negative state uses لَنْ يَكُونَ.

blocks: ## Why this matters لِمَاذَا نَسْتَعْمِلُ لَيْسَ؟
Accurate negation depends on whether you are denying a state, an action, a past fact or a future possibility.
### Core
Negate identity, description and location with لَيْسَ.
### Develop
Conjugate لَيْسَ and control human plural word order.
### Stretch
Contrast لَيْسَ with لَا, لَمْ يَكُنْ and لَنْ يَكُونَ.
[callout] Communication target: say clearly what someone or something is not, where it is not and how the negative state changes across time.
## Diagnostic start
Identify state negation, agreement and time-frame choices.
## Negating the present nominal sentence
لَيْسَ works like a negative member of the kāna family.

TABLE: Positive | Negative | Meaning // أَحْمَدُ طَبِيبٌ. | لَيْسَ أَحْمَدُ طَبِيبًا. | Ahmad is not a doctor. // الْغُرْفَةُ كَبِيرَةٌ. | لَيْسَتِ الْغُرْفَةُ كَبِيرَةً. | The room is not large. // مَرْيَمُ فِي الْبَيْتِ. | لَيْسَتْ مَرْيَمُ فِي الْبَيْتِ. | Maryam is not at home.
[callout] Case-aware pattern: لَيْسَ + اسْمُهَا الْمَرْفُوعُ + خَبَرُهَا الْمَنْصُوبُ . A prepositional predicate keeps its own case.
## Conjugating لَيْسَ
The form agrees with the person, gender and number.

TABLE: Subject | Form | Model // أنا | لَسْتُ | لَسْتُ مُتْعَبَةً. // أنتَ / أنتِ | لَسْتَ / لَسْتِ | لَسْتِ مُتَأَخِّرَةً. // هو | لَيْسَ | لَيْسَ مَشْغُولًا. // هي | لَيْسَتْ | لَيْسَتْ مَشْغُولَةً. // نحن | لَسْنَا | لَسْنَا فِي الْبَيْتِ. // هم | لَيْسُوا | لَيْسُوا مُسْتَعِدِّينَ. // هنّ | لَسْنَ | لَسْنَ مُسْتَعِدَّاتٍ.
[callout/warning] Order matters with human plurals: لَيْسَ الطُّلَّابُ فِي الْفَصْلِ is formal verb-first agreement; الطُّلَّابُ لَيْسُوا فِي الْفَصْلِ is subject-first full agreement.
## State negation versus action negation
Choose the negative system from the meaning and sentence type.

TABLE: What is negated? | Pattern | Model // present identity/description | لَيْسَ | لَيْسَ أَخِي طَبِيبًا. // present location | لَيْسَ | لَيْسَ أَخِي فِي الْمَكْتَبِ. // present/habitual action | لَا + present | لَا يَعْمَلُ أَخِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ. // past action | مَا + past / لَمْ + jussive | لَمْ يَعْمَلْ أَخِي أَمْسِ. // future action | لَنْ + subjunctive | لَنْ يَعْمَلَ أَخِي غَدًا.
[callout/warning] Key contrast: لَيْسَ أَخِي فِي الْمَكْتَبِ denies a location; لَا يَعْمَلُ أَخِي فِي الْمَكْتَبِ denies an action or habitual fact.
## Negative states across time
Use يَكُونُ when the state must be placed in the past or future through verbal particles.

TABLE: Time | Model | Meaning // present | لَيْسَ الطَّرِيقُ مُزْدَحِمًا. | The road is not crowded. // past | لَمْ يَكُنِ الطَّرِيقُ مُزْدَحِمًا أَمْسِ. | The road was not crowded yesterday. // future | لَنْ يَكُونَ الطَّرِيقُ مُزْدَحِمًا غَدًا. | The road will not be crowded tomorrow.
[callout] Stretch: Formal Arabic may strengthen a negative predicate with an extra بِـ: لَيْسَ الْأَمْرُ بِصَعْبٍ . The core productive target remains لَيْسَ الْأَمْرُ صَعْبًا .
## Misconception clinic
Choose the negative tool before repairing endings.

TABLE: Draft | Improved version | Reason // لَيْسَ هِيَ مُتْعَبَةٌ. | لَيْسَتْ مُتْعَبَةً. | Conjugate لَيْسَ; predicate accusative. // لَسْتُ طَالِبٌ. | لَسْتُ طَالِبًا. | Single-word predicate accusative. // لَيْسَ أَذْهَبُ الْيَوْمَ. | لَا أَذْهَبُ الْيَوْمَ. | This negates a present action. // لَيْسَ الطَّقْسُ بَارِدًا أَمْسِ. | لَمْ يَكُنِ الطَّقْسُ بَارِدًا أَمْسِ. | Past negative state. // لَمْ يَكُنِ الطَّقْسُ بَارِدًا غَدًا. | لَنْ يَكُونَ الطَّقْسُ بَارِدًا غَدًا. | Future negative state.
## Game: Which negative system?
Choose the form that matches sentence type, person and time frame.
## Skills workshop
Correct misleading claims and write a balanced description.
[ar] يَظُنُّ بَعْضُ النَّاسِ أَنَّ الْمَدِينَةَ صَاخِبَةٌ دَائِمًا، وَلَكِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ صَاخِبَةً فِي الصَّبَاحِ الْبَاكِرِ.
[ar] لَمْ يَكُنِ الطَّقْسُ جَمِيلًا أَمْسِ، وَلَكِنَّهُ لَنْ يَكُونَ بَارِدًا غَدًا.
### Correct three misconceptions
Write 100–120 Arabic words about a place, person or activity. State three things that are true and correct three things that are not true.
[callout] Success checklist: Use at least three forms of لَيْسَ, one present action negative, one لَمْ يَكُنْ past state and one لَنْ يَكُونَ future state.
[callout] Paper route: Make a truth/myth table first. Underline each negative form and label it state, action, past or future.
## Final mastery check
Select the correct negative system and maintain agreement.
### What you can now do
- Negate present identity, description and location with لَيْسَ.
- Conjugate لَيْسَ for common persons and groups.
- Distinguish state negation from action negation.
- Express negative states in present, past and future time frames.
Spaced revisit: take five positive statements from Lesson 1 and negate them without looking at this page.
